_doc: Host calibration timings made outside the tracker (jobs/calib.py reads this beside tracked `calibration` jobs).
A suite is ONE piece of work: same input, tool build, options and thread count. Each run cites where its
number was read. elapsed_s is the TOOL'S OWN elapsed time where it reports one (a tracked job's wall time is
quantized to its polling interval: the 2026-07-21 jobs read 201 s against Spectre's 187 s). A run the source
records as taken under load carries `excluded` with the reason and is not used: contention is not speed.
